user.title: Tado X Matter Pro
user.description: Settings for the whole house. Add the rooms afterwards with "Add room" on the integration page.

data_description.idle_sensors: While any of these is on, every room uses its idle temperature (e.g. away or vacation mode).
data_description.frost_temperature: No room drops below this, even when it is switched off or a window is open.

data_description.only_below: Remind only when it is colder outside. Empty: always.
data_description.notify: Notification actions, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. The minutes are set per room.

data_description.name: Empty: the area of the first thermostat.
data_description.thermostats: All radiator thermostats of the room. A thermostat can belong to one room only.
data_description.schedule: A schedule helper: during its blocks the room uses its heating temperature, or the block's own "temperature" (additional data).
data_description.windows: Contacts that switch the room off while open.
data_description.room_sensor: Optional. Shown as the room's temperature; without it, the thermostats' mean.

data_description.open_delay: How long a window must be open before the room switches off. Shorter openings are ignored.
data_description.close_delay: How long to wait after the last window closed.
